title: It Makes No Difference: cueste lo que cueste, diga lo que diga, quieras o no
goal: Say that nothing changes with the repeated subjunctive, in the present and in the past.
grammar: cueste lo que cueste, diga lo que diga, quieras o no

items: I can use *cueste lo que cueste*, *pase lo que pase* and *diga lo que diga*.
I can use *quieras o no* for "whether you like it or not".
I can use the imperfect subjunctive twice to talk about the past.
